format: DP Black Star Promos (DPP DP01-DP56, 2007-2009): every card came out before Black & White, so the set is Unlimited only. Tropical Wind 25 and 48 are prints of Tropical Wind 5, Dialga LV.X 37 of Dialga LV.X 17, Palkia LV.X 18 of the 30th Celebration Classic Collection's (30C CC12) and Garchomp C LV.X 46 of Celebrations' (CEL CC18).
